description: This PHP source file defines the 'NationalityService' class, which provides methods to manage nationality data within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with 'NationalityDao' for data access operations and supports functions like listing, counting, saving, retrieving by ID or name, deletion, and normalization of nationality data.

classes.name: NationalityService
classes.description: Service class responsible for business logic related to Nationality entities, acting as an intermediary between controllers and data access objects.

methods.name: getNationalityDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of NationalityDao, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: setNationalityDao
methods.description: Sets the NationalityDao instance, allowing for dependency injection.

methods.name: getNationalityList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of nationalities based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getNationalityCount
methods.description: Returns the count of nationalities matching the search criteria.

methods.name: saveNationality
methods.description: Saves a Nationality entity to the database.

methods.name: getNationalityById
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by its unique ID.

methods.name: getNationalityByName
methods.description: Fetches a Nationality entity by its name.

methods.name: deleteNationalities
methods.description: Deletes multiple nationality records based on an array of IDs.

methods.name: isExistingNationalityName
methods.description: Checks if a nationality name already exists.

methods.name: getNationalityArray
methods.description: Returns an array of nationality data normalized into models, typically for API responses.
